test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is option 3, "**able**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**- The passage is about spiders and their habitats.

- There are up to 50,000 species of spiders.

- Spiders can live anywhere in the world except Antarctica.

- They cannot live in bodies of water or in the air.

- Spiders can adapt to almost any type of environment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**- Spiders are arachnids, not insects.

- Some common spider habitats include forests, deserts, and grasslands.

- Spiders play an important role in controlling insect populations."
